requirements.description: User prefers a location near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics). Value set to the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution, since 'near' implies a high proximity score.

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area. The 18-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

User requires energy class D or better. Translated to the set of classes A1 through D. Classes E, F and G are excluded. The energy_score_class legend cannot isolate D-or-better (score 3 covers B-E), so the energy_class column is used.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 360 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area of at least 360 sqm, energy class A1 through D, and healthcare score of at least 75. Location is limited to a 3.0 km radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892 using haversine distance on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance from that point, nearest first. The capacity of 18 people has no matching column and is not filtered on.
